entries.summary: POAP KINGS: 5321 battles in 1344 sessions by 48 players who were members during the window (roster now 47) since Sep 3; joined: NOBITA, Brotherinpants, ㅤᴀɴᴅᴇʀㅤ:), VVSBUDGET; left: Prince Aravind, Ram, pax, Ditaka, Th15_Guy +1; roles: pax elder→member, Th15_Guy elder→member; roster 50→47; war day 4 (race finished): 35 untouched, 3 partial, 8 finished of 46; quiet past 5d: sniperhendo (6d); back: pokemon after 10d; most battles: Aaqib Javed 582, Vijay 438, bonus 309; standout sessions: NOBITA 10W-34L -34, L-Drxgo⚡ 24W-24L, Aaqib Javed 23W-18L; donations this week 8,977, led by Aaqib Javed (915).

notes: Window spans S135 (2026-08) and S136 (2026-09); the season rolls on the first Monday at 10:00Z and applied.window.crosses says where, so read either side as its own season.

timeline is oldest first: named moments with an instant, each with text a person can read; entries summarize the same window per subject. Nothing here is advice, and nothing announces the time: schedule from game_clock.

Profile-derived moments (badges, collection level, new bests, cards unlocked, arena and ranked moves) are recorded from 2026-09-14T04:27Z: a window before that has none of them, which is the ledger's start, not a quiet week. collection_level_step items before 2026-09-18 predate the step rule and carry no facts.step.
